trust_decision.summary: Whether a node-type attribute object taken from the clipboard's `data-pm-slice` context JSON may be turned into a document node without passing the schema's attribute validators: the decision is made in `addContext`, which calls `type.create(attrs)` with no validation.

landing_point.why: It is the only place clipboard-supplied attribute objects become document nodes; an engineer who reads 'XSS in paste handling' follows parseFromClipboard (src/clipboard.ts:95) to this slice-context restore loop.

fix_sites.entry_point: DOM paste event (src/input.ts:708), DOM drop event (src/input.ts:774) and EditorView.pasteHTML (src/index.ts:440), all via parseFromClipboard
fix_sites.module_kind: clipboard deserialization module in the view package; browser/DOM layer with no HTTP route or CLI

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Restoring the ancestry of a selection copied from a nested context: context attrs are serialized as null when they equal the type defaults and as {} for attr-less types, and the loop must still wrap the pasted content so the slice keeps its open depths. A fix that rejects non-plain-object attrs, requires a validated object, or abandons the context on any failure flattens legitimate blockquote/list pastes and breaks the openStart/openEnd round trip.

O6_input_shapes: context JSON array of alternating type-name / attrs pairs as written by serializeForClipboard (src/clipboard.ts:34)
attrs = null for an ancestor whose attrs equal the type defaults (src/clipboard.ts:13)
attrs = {} for an attr-less ancestor type (test/webtest-clipboard.ts:23)
schema-specific attr objects carrying values a schema attribute validator rejects (fix.diff:48)
several nested ancestor levels, restored innermost-first (src/clipboard.ts:270)
unknown node type names in the context array, which abort the restore (src/clipboard.ts:271)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: withWrappers creates wrapper nodes while normalising pasted siblings; a sibling could take attrs from the surrounding parse context instead of passing null.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: normalizeSiblings already has to synthesise wrapper nodes for foreign HTML at src/clipboard.ts:122-145, so a maintainer adding context preservation there is a small, natural step.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A symmetric validate-on-serialize branch that filters attrs before they are written into data-pm-slice.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Cross-schema copy/paste is exactly why the context blob exists, so validating on the copy side (rather than the paste side) is a plausible alternative a maintainer could have chosen.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second attribute-application path (patched decorations / node views) that writes attr names to the DOM without any sanitisation of its own.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: patchAttributes is where attribute objects actually reach setAttribute (src/viewdesc.ts:1138), so a maintainer hardening attributes would likely touch this separate renderer as well.

O10_build.toolchain: npm; @prosemirror/buildhelper (pm-buildhelper compiles src/index.ts, pm-runtests runs the mocha suite)
services: headless browser/webdriver required by pm-runtests for `npm test` (test/view.ts:19 mounts a real DOM)
O10_build.project_tests: test/webtest-clipboard.ts exercises serializeForClipboard/parseFromClipboard round trips, including slice context at lines 18-35; nothing covers schema attribute validators and the fix adds no test.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip dangerous-looking keys (on*, javascript: URLs) from the context attrs, or sanitise the attrs by hand, instead of re-running the schema's own attribute validators, leaving every other schema-declared validation bypassed.

out_of_scope_notes: The non-ProseMirror HTML clipboard path (src/clipboard.ts:83-92) builds nodes through prosemirror-model's DOMParser, which lives in a different repository (package.json:31), so whether it validates attrs is outside this repository.
unverified: prosemirror-model ^1.25.8 is not vendored at the pinned commit, so `NodeType.checkAttrs` internals could not be read: whether it tolerates a null attrs argument (serialized at src/clipboard.ts:13) is unknown, which also decides whether the two-line published fix itself drops context for default-attrs ancestors.
repo_mb could not be measured without shell access; the pinned tree holds 12 TypeScript files under src/ and 12 under test/ with no vendored dependencies, so it is far under 5 MB.
The internal export `__parseFromClipboard` (src/index.ts:22-23, marked @internal) is a fourth callable surface reaching the flaw but was not counted as a public entry point.
